og_title: The Black Desert’s Deadliest Secret – Iron Fire Ants
og_description: Han Li watches a cultivator get devoured in seconds, then coldly dissects the Iron Fire Ants’ biology to plan his next move.
twitter_title: Han Li vs. The Un-tameable Insect Swarm
twitter_description: The sallow-faced cultivator didn’t last ten seconds. Han Li is already running the numbers on how to cross a desert full of Iron Fire Ants.

lore_anchors.definition: A spirit insect ranked 37th on the Strange Insect List. Impervious to most spells and blade-proof. It spits black flames, can combine into a swarm-spear, but cannot be bound by any master—any binding ritual causes the ants to self-destruct.

A tiered ranking of spirit insects in the cultivation world, functioning as a survival manual for cultivators. Higher rank does not always mean stronger in every situation, but it provides a baseline for assessing threat level.

A legendary spiritual insect, higher-ranked than Iron Fire Ants, capable of devouring spiritual power. Han Li’s beetles are in a semi-mature state, making their performance against the Iron Fire Ants uncertain.
A defensive magical item that projects a white barrier capable of resisting extreme heat; essential for navigating the black desert without being cooked alive.
The floating jade palace in the sky, a central dungeon of this arc. The black desert was created by its original master as a protective measure.
